primitives.note: Staggering Blow adds bonus physical damage to basic attacks, limited to once per 6s per target
Dredge Line deals a single magic damage instance on hitting the dummy
While the shield holds, basic attacks apply Pain of Wrath to the target
Titan's Wrath's empowered attack resets Nautilus' basic attack timer
Pain of Wrath deals half its damage immediately, half after 1.25s
Riptide fires three separately timed wave damage instances from one cast, later waves reduced to 50%
Depth Charge deals periodic underway eruption damage every 0.25s while chasing, then a larger final eruption on reaching the target
Mana costs (60/60/50-90/100) against a 15s fight may cap total casts, especially with low starting mana
Titan's Wrath's shield (base + % max HP) only matters for damage taken in the survival fight
Number of underway Depth Charge eruptions that land on a stationary dummy before the final eruption depends on assumed cast range and the charge's accelerating travel speed

needsBespoke.why: Depth Charge (R) needs bespoke chase/acceleration logic (starts at 275 units/s, accelerates by 466.67/s, erupts every 0.25s) to determine how many underway damage instances land on a stationary dummy before the larger final eruption at the target's location; this can't be captured by a fixed-count multipart primitive without an assumed travel distance. Titan's Wrath (W)'s Pain of Wrath also needs bespoke stacking-cap logic: reapplying it while active adds a stack that does not restart the tick timer and deals no additional damage, which is stricter than a generic dot/onhit-rider primitive would assume.

unsettled.question: How many underway Depth Charge (R) eruptions should be assumed to hit a stationary dummy before the final eruption lands?
options: Assume the charge reaches the target almost immediately (0-1 underway hits) since dummy doesn't move and cast range is close
Assume a mid-range cast (e.g. 600-800 units) yielding roughly 2-4 underway eruptions given the accelerating speed formula
Ignore underway eruptions entirely and only count the final eruption's damage
quotes: creating eruptions every {{rutngt|0.25}} in its wake
Upon reaching the primary target, the ''Depth Charge'' erupts a final time at their location.

unsettled.question: Do Riptide's (E) second and third wave hits on the same stationary dummy count as separate damage instances (each able to proc on-hit/on-damage item and rune effects), or is the reduction just a single combined damage number?
options: Treat each of the three waves as a separate damage instance against the dummy since it never leaves the overlapping hit radius
Treat only the first wave as a real 'hit' and the later waves as passive damage-over-time ticks that don't proc on-hit effects
quotes: Each wave deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 50% against those hit by subsequent waves beyond the first
The first wave happens at 0 seconds after the cast time ends, the second wave at {{fd|0.297}} seconds and the third wave at {{fd|0.561}} seconds.

unsettled.question: Passive (P) bonus damage per level is given in the bin only as an unresolved ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart; is the wiki's stated linear interpolation formula (14 + (116-14)/17*(level-1)) exactly what the game uses, or could the live formula differ from this reconstruction at some levels?
options: Trust the wiki's linear interpolation formula exactly as given
Treat the per-level values as uncertain outside the levels the wiki explicitly cross-checks, pending the unresolved bin formula

proposal: Open by casting Q (Dredge Line) on the dummy for its magic damage hit and to close to melee range.
Immediately follow with W (Titan's Wrath) to raise the shield and arm the next basic attacks with Pain of Wrath.
Cast R (Depth Charge) on the dummy early, since its long cooldown (80-120s) means it can only be used once in the 15s fight.

Auto-attack continuously between ability casts: this triggers Staggering Blow's bonus damage (once per 6s per target) and, while the W shield holds, applies and refreshes Pain of Wrath, resetting the attack timer each time it lands.
Cast E (Riptide) on cooldown for its three-wave AoE damage against the dummy.
Recast Q and W again as soon as they come off cooldown, always weaving basic attacks in between to keep Pain of Wrath and Staggering Blow procs active as much as possible.
Do not attempt to recast R, since even at max rank its 80s cooldown exceeds the 15s fight window.
questions: What cast range against the dummy should be assumed for Depth Charge, since it directly determines how many underway eruptions land before the final burst?
Should R be cast at the very start of the fight to maximize the number of full-cooldown windows for Q/W/E, or held until W's shield and Pain of Wrath are already active to add onto the burst?
Given Q's cost (60) and W's cost (60) and E's rising cost (50-90) plus R's 100, does mana realistically run out before 15s at typical starting mana/regen, capping the number of casts of each spell?
